summary: Mobile preview and required backend flows tested. Home, navigation, offer filters, membership join, 60-second code, club state, concierge enquiry, gallery and notifications rendered successfully.

critical.issue: customer_id is optional and the endpoint accepts enquiries without membership; membership gating exists only in the UI, so the API can be bypassed directly.

integration_issues.issue: Selecting Enquire opens the sign-in modal, but after joining the selected manager/form context is discarded; the user must find and open Enquire again.

action_items: Enforce a valid customer_id/member lookup (or authenticated session) in POST /api/inquiries.
Preserve the selected manager and reopen the enquiry form after successful sign-in, or clearly guide the member back to it.
Add stable testID attributes to navigation, filters, form inputs, modal actions, offer claims and enquiry controls for reliable mobile regression tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API configuration uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL key; align naming or document the intentional Expo public-key convention.
Interactive controls generally lack testID attributes, reducing reliable automated coverage.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed customer and inquiry through the public API; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview: https://mobile-app-staging-29.preview.emergentagent.com. QA member used qa.mobile.2026@example.com; credentials file contains no predefined credentials. Browser console had no app error surfaced. One Playwright assertion stopped on duplicate Promotion gallery text after the successful enquiry, not an app failure.
rca_of_issue: The UI's More.submit() calls setSelected(null) before opening SignInModal when customer is absent. Successful sign-in only closes SignInModal in session.tsx and does not restore selected manager/form state. Separately, InquiryInput.customer_id is Optional and create_inquiry only validates manager existence, allowing direct unauthenticated POSTs.
